title: Students and activists protest at Dharna Chowk against SIR

tea.why: Protesters opposed the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and police actions against demonstrators in New Delhi.
tea.want: They demanded the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner and the scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision.
tea.changed: Oct 11: Students and activists staged a protest demonstration at Dharna Chowk in Hyderabad.

summary: Students, activists, and citizens gathered at Dharna Chowk in Hyderabad on Sunday, October 11, to protest against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and recent police actions against demonstrators in New Delhi. Organised under the Bhagat Singh Jan Adhikar Yatra along with the Disha Students Organisation, the participants condemned what they described as an emergency-like situation and the restriction of constitutional rights in the capital. Speakers alleged that the electoral revision was being weaponized to strip vulnerable groups such as Muslims, Dalits, Adivasis, migrant workers, and women of their voting rights by rejecting standard identification documents. The demonstration featured calls for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, alongside speeches by student representatives and figures such as retired IAS Akunuri Murali.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Rollback and scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision
response: No official response reported in the sources.
